<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <!-- This module was also published with a richer model, Gradle metadata,  -->
  <!-- which should be used instead. Do not delete the following line which  -->
  <!-- is to indicate to Gradle or any Gradle module metadata file consumer  -->
  <!-- that they should prefer consuming it instead. -->
  <!-- do_not_remove: published-with-gradle-metadata -->
  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
  <groupId>org.mattshoe.shoebox</groupId>
  <artifactId>Kdux.gson</artifactId>
  <version>1.0.6</version>
  <packaging>aar</packaging>
  <name>Kdux</name>
  <description>Kdux is a Kotlin-based, platform-agnostic state management library that implements the Redux pattern, 
providing structured concurrency with built-in coroutine support. It is designed to integrate seamlessly 
with any Kotlin project, particularly excelling in Android applications using MVI architecture.</description>
  <url>https://github.com/mattshoe/kdux</url>
  <inceptionYear>2024</inceptionYear>
  <licenses>
    <license>
      <name>The Apache License, Version 2.0</name>
      <url>http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.txt</url>
    </license>
  </licenses>
  <developers>
    <developer>
      <id>mattshoe</id>
      <name>Matthew Shoemaker</name>
      <email>person@example.test</email>
    </developer>
  </developers>
  <scm>
    <connection>scm:git:person@example.test:mattshoe/kdux.git</connection>
    <developerConnection>scm:git:person@example.test:mattshoe/kdux.git</developerConnection>
    <url>https://github.com/mattshoe/kdux</url>
  </scm>
  <properties>
    <myProp>value</myProp>
  </properties>
  <dependencies>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.jetbrains.kotlin</groupId>
      <artifactId>kotlin-stdlib</artifactId>
      <version>2.0.10-RC2</version>
      <scope>compile</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.mattshoe.shoebox</groupId>
      <artifactId>Kdux</artifactId>
      <version>1.0.6</version>
      <scope>runtime</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.google.code.gson</groupId>
      <artifactId>gson</artifactId>
      <version>2.11.0</version>
      <scope>runtime</scope>
    </dependency>
  </dependencies>
</project>

<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
	xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
	<modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
	<parent>
		<groupId>com.commsen.wedeploy</groupId>
		<artifactId>parent</artifactId>
		<version>1.0.0</version>
	</parent>

	<artifactId>com.commsen.wedeploy.data.mapper.gson</artifactId>
	<name>WeDeploy Java client :: mapper :: gson</name>
	<description>
		Module provides Gson based implementation of data mapper used by "WeDeploy Java client :: data".
	</description>

	<properties>
		<_.eccentric.modularity.metadata />
		<site.dir>${project.basedir}/../../../wedeploy-client-site</site.dir>
	</properties>

	<dependencies>
		<dependency>
			<groupId>com.commsen.wedeploy</groupId>
			<artifactId>com.commsen.wedeploy.client</artifactId>
		</dependency>
		<dependency>
			<groupId>com.commsen.em</groupId>
			<artifactId>em.annotations</artifactId>
			<optional>true</optional>
		</dependency>
		<dependency>
			<groupId>com.google.code.gson</groupId>
			<artifactId>gson</artifactId>
		</dependency>
		<!-- test -->
		<dependency>
			<groupId>com.commsen.wedeploy</groupId>
			<artifactId>com.commsen.wedeploy.client</artifactId>
			<type>test-jar</type>
			<scope>test</scope>
		</dependency>
		<dependency>
			<groupId>junit</groupId>
			<artifactId>junit</artifactId>
			<scope>test</scope>
		</dependency>
	</dependencies>

	<build>
		<plugins>
			<plugin>
				<groupId>biz.aQute.bnd</groupId>
				<artifactId>bnd-baseline-maven-plugin</artifactId>
			</plugin>
		</plugins>
	</build>

</project>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd" xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
    xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <!-- This module was also published with a richer model, Gradle metadata,  -->
  <!-- which should be used instead. Do not delete the following line which  -->
  <!-- is to indicate to Gradle or any Gradle module metadata file consumer  -->
  <!-- that they should prefer consuming it instead. -->

  <groupId>com.liferay</groupId>
  <artifactId>com.liferay.shared.dependencies.gson</artifactId>

  <description>Liferay Shared Dependencies Gson</description>

  </developers>
  <scm>
    <connection>scm:git:person@example.test:liferay/liferay-portal.git</connection>
    <developerConnection>scm:git:person@example.test:liferay/liferay-portal.git</developerConnection>

<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
		 xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
		 xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0
		 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
	<modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
	<parent>
		<groupId>de.gerdi-project</groupId>
		<artifactId>GeRDI-parent</artifactId>
		<version>4.1.0</version>
	</parent>
	
	<artifactId>GSON</artifactId>
	<version>6.0.6</version>
	<packaging>jar</packaging>
	<name>GSON</name>
	<description>This library provides helper functions and common JSON structures using GSON.</description>
	<inceptionYear>2017</inceptionYear>

	<properties>
		<gson.dependency.version>2.8.5</gson.dependency.version>
		<jsoup.dependency.version>1.11.3</jsoup.dependency.version>
		<jts.dependency.version>1.13</jts.dependency.version>
	</properties>

	<profiles>
		<profile>
			<id>generateConstants</id>
			<activation>
				<property>
					<name>generate</name>
				</property>
			</activation>
			<build>
				<plugins>
					<plugin>
						<groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
						<artifactId>exec-maven-plugin</artifactId>
						<version>${exec.plugin.version}</version>
						<executions>
							<!-- generate classes -->
							<execution>
								<id>Generate Classes</id>
								<goals>
									<goal>java</goal>
								</goals>
								<phase>compile</phase>
								<configuration>
									<mainClass>de.gerdiproject.generator.research.utils.ResearchGenerator</mainClass>
								</configuration>
							</execution>
							
							<!-- format generated classes -->
							<execution>
								<id>Format Code</id>
								<phase>compile</phase>
								<goals>
									<goal>exec</goal>
								</goals>
								<configuration>
									<executable>${project.build.directory}/harvester-utils/scripts/formatting/astyle-format.${script.extension}</executable>
								</configuration>
							</execution>
						</executions>
					</plugin>
				</plugins>
			</build>
		</profile>
	</profiles>

	<dependencies>
		<!-- https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/com.google.code.gson/gson -->
		<dependency>
			<groupId>com.google.code.gson</groupId>
			<artifactId>gson</artifactId>
			<version>${gson.dependency.version}</version>
		</dependency>
		
		<!-- https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/org.jsoup/jsoup -->
		<dependency>
			<groupId>org.jsoup</groupId>
			<artifactId>jsoup</artifactId>
			<version>${jsoup.dependency.version}</version>
		</dependency>
		
        <!-- https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/com.vividsolutions/jts -->
		<dependency>
			<groupId>com.vividsolutions</groupId>
			<artifactId>jts</artifactId>
			<version>${jts.dependency.version}</version>
		</dependency>
	</dependencies>

	<developers>
		<developer>
			<name>Robin Weiss</name>
			<email>person@example.test</email>
			<organization>Kiel University</organization>
			<organizationUrl>http://www.uni-kiel.de/index-e.shtml</organizationUrl>
		</developer>
		<developer>
			<name>Fidan Limani</name>
			<email>person@example.test</email>
			<organization>ZBW</organization>
			<organizationUrl>https://www.zbw.eu</organizationUrl>
		</developer>
	</developers>

	<!-- Define Sonatype repository for retrieving SNAPSHOT versions -->
	<repositories>
		<repository>
			<id>Sonatype</id>
			<url>https://oss.sonatype.org/content/repositories/snapshots/</url>
		</repository>
	</repositories>
</project>
